description: Maximum and Minimum System Load (MW) is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by KAHRAMAA. This dataset records the maximum and minimum electrical system loads in megawatts (MW) observed annually in Qatar. Each entry includes the highest and lowest demand values along with the corresponding dates. The data helps monitor national electricity consumption trends, peak demand periods, and off-peak usage, supporting planning and operational efficiency. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher KAHRAMAA. Its tags are electricity, load, demand, peak, minimum. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-06-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
